playstyle.identity: Skarner is a pick-focused tank who drags enemies out of position with his ultimate. His reworked kit gives him CC and durability to reach priority targets.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q is a charged slam that stuns (needs charge). W has two parts: first gives shield and speed, second grabs/throws enemies/terrain. E impales in a line. R suppresses and drags a target with you. Flash R to grab carries and drag them to your team.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Skarner spikes at level 6 with his drag ultimate. Tank items make him durable. He's strong when he can isolate targets.

passive.name: Threads of Vibration
passive.summary: Abilities apply stacks that deal bonus damage at 3 stacks.
passive.details: Skarner's abilities apply Quaking stacks. At 3 stacks, they detonate to deal bonus percent max health damage.

abilities.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
abilities.summary: Rip out a rock; throw it to stun enemies.
abilities.details: Skarner rips out a rock, empowering his next attack. Throw the rock to deal damage and stun enemies hit. Can store multiple charges.

abilities.name: Seismic Bastion
abilities.summary: Gain a shield; recast to slam and damage enemies.
abilities.details: Skarner surrounds himself with a shield and gains movement speed. Recast to slam the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Ixtal's Impact
abilities.summary: Charge forward, ignoring terrain; grab and drag the first champion hit.
abilities.details: Skarner charges in a direction, ignoring terrain. He grabs the first enemy champion hit, carrying them with him before throwing them.

abilities.name: Impale
abilities.summary: Suppress a target and drag them with you.
abilities.details: Skarner impales an enemy champion, suppressing them and dragging them with him for a few seconds. Deals damage when the suppression ends.
